slides.title: Fog. You hear *one long blast*. What is it?
One prolonged blast
slides.body: Power-driven vessel making way through the water. Every 2 minutes or less.

slides.title: Two prolonged blasts
slides.body: Power-driven vessel underway but stopped, making no way. About 2 seconds between them.

slides.title: One prolonged, two short
slides.body: Not under command, restricted in ability to manoeuvre, constrained by draught, sailing, fishing, or towing/pushing.

slides.title: One prolonged, three short
slides.body: The vessel towed (the last one, if manned). When practicable, right after the towing vessel's signal.

slides.title: Bell, rapidly, about 5 seconds
slides.body: Vessel at anchor, at least every minute. 100 m or more: bell forward, then gong aft.

slides.question: Which one do you hear most on watch?
slides.line: Practise COLREGs in the Learn tab.
